QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] A Gift For Sis
QuestInfo.0: You wonder if #b#p2152009##k of #m310000000# understands her sister now...
QuestInfo.1:
Though she doesn't know the specifics, #p2152009# says she finally understands why her big sister is always so busy and promises that she won't get upset at her sister anymore. #p2152009# wants to give her big sister a picture of her, so that she won't forget about her. Find #b#t4032762##k, which was stolen by some #r#o3150000# Signs#k a long time ago, and deliver it to #b#p2152004##k.

#i4032762# #t4032762# #b#c4032762#/1#k

0.0: Hiya, #h0#. Long time no see. La ti da, do I seem like I'm in a good mood? Of course I am! I just found out why my sister is always so busy! What's the reason? The reason is...a secret!
0.1: What's important is that my sister is doing something important for the town. So I've decided to not get upset with her no matter how much I miss her. Hehe.
0.2: One other thing, though. What if my sister's so busy that she forgets how I look? She is really, really smart, so she probably won't forget, but still, I'm super-worried... Do you think you can help me?

yes.0: Give my sister this picture, so I can be near her even when she's working. I can't hand it to her myself, because, well...
yes.1: When I ran away, one of the #r#o3150000# Signs#k stole my pictures, and I don't know which one it was! Defeat the #o3150000# Signs, retrieve my #bpicture#k, and deliver it to my #bsister#k!

no.0: Oh come on, you can't abandon me now! You're the only one who can help me, #h0#!

1.0: Huh? What is it? Has #p2152009# asked something of you again? She wanted you to deliver this to me?

yes.0: This...is #t4032762#. I would never forget #p2152009#'s face. She is such a child. But thank you for humoring her.

npc.0: Have you not found the picture yet? Or are you not able to find my sister? The picture is with the #r#o3150000# Signs#k and my #bsister is on the stairs opposite us#k!

item.0: What is it? Has #p2152009# been bothering you again?
